text:
jamie_supp: FYI customer ACME on Dedicated is seeing a sudden spike in 429s since ~09:12 UTC after we upgraded their pool. They report ~100% failures: "tenant_rate_limit"
leo_infra: Pinged logs, seeing a concentrated stream of 429s from tenant acme-prod. Can you paste the tenant id and sample request ids?
jamie_supp: tenant=acme-prod, sample req ids: rq_8b2f, rq_8b30, rq_8b45. Customer says they didn’t change anything on their side.
anya_prod: Do we have per-tenant QPS quotas applied on Dedicated? Remind me which layers throttle (gateway vs runtime).
leo_infra: Both. Gateway enforces soft burst limits, runtime enforces strict per-tenant token/QPS caps. Looking at current quota snapshot for acme-prod:```bash
$ redwood-admin tenant get-quotas --tenant acme-prod
{
  "tenant": "acme-prod",
  "global_qps": "1000",
  "per_tenant_qps": "25",
  "burst_capacity": "200",
  "last_updated_by": "deploy-bot"
}
```
jamie_supp: Wait wut. They were on Dedicated 250 QPS committed. How did per_tenant_qps become 25?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Applied config change to /infra/deploy/tenants/acme-prod.yaml at 2026-03-17T09:10:31Z (commit d3f4c9e)
leo_infra: Reproducing locally against their dedicated pool with a 50 RPS client:```bash
$ seq 1 100 | xargs -P50 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer <acme-token>" https://dedicated-host/acme/v1/generate
429
429
429
... (all 429s)
```
anya_prod: That timing matches the deploy-bot update. Looks like a templating bug pushed a default per_tenant_qps=25 for this tenant. Probably a bad interpolation in the capacity template.
jamie_supp: Customer is escalated — they’re losing production traffic. We need a hotfix. Can we bump per_tenant_qps to the expected 250 immediately?
leo_infra: I can change the runtime quota while we fix the template. Applying change now to runtime control plane:```bash
$ redwood-admin tenant set-quota --tenant acme-prod --per_tenant_qps 250
OK: per_tenant_qps updated for acme-prod -> 250
```
ops-bot: ops-bot: Runtime quota update successful for tenant acme-prod at 2026-03-17T09:22:10Z
leo_infra: Waiting for propagation to gateway and runtime nodes. Running another quick repro.```bash
$ seq 1 50 | xargs -P50 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer <acme-token>" https://dedicated-host/acme/v1/generate
200
200
200
... (200 responses)
```
jamie_supp: Customer confirms recovery, thanks.
anya_prod: Root cause summary: deploy template accidentally set per_tenant_qps to the wrong variable (used ${defaults.small_qps} for tenants with dedicated tags). Commit d3f4c9e dropped a default that overrides tenant-specific commit.
leo_infra: Created hotfix PR to infra repo replacing that interpolation with ${tenant.commit_qps} and added a safety check that refuses values < 50 for dedicated tenants. PR: https://git.internal/infra/changes/PR-482 (will merge after approvals).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Noted rollback not required, runtime change handled.
anya_prod: Follow-ups: 1) Add unit test to template rendering to catch numeric field substitutions. 2) Add alert on per_tenant_qps drop > 5x in last 10m. 3) Notify SRE and Sales about impact.
jamie_supp: I'll draft an incident note for ACME and include timeline + mitigation + follow-ups.
leo_infra: Logged postmortem ticket: INFRA-792. Root cause: templating bug in tenant deploy pipeline, secondary cause: no low-value threshold guard. Fixes: template change + guard + monitoring.
anya_prod: Marking resolved for now, will keep thread open until PR merged and monitoring in place. :white_check_mark:
